today.title: Today
today.allCaughtUpBody: Nothing needs you right now. Sprout will let you know when it's time to check on someone.
today.lastMoist: Last time it was still moist.
today.waterTip: Feel the top 2″ of soil — water only if it's dry.
today.howFinger: Finger — poke to your second knuckle (~2″). Cool or damp? Wait. Dry? Water.
today.howChopstick: Chopstick — push in, pull out. Comes out clean and dry means it's time.
today.howLift: Lift the pot — light = dry, heavy = still wet. Learn the feel right after watering.
today.repotTip: Tip it out of the pot. Roots circling the bottom or poking out the drainage hole? Time for a pot one size up.
today.fertilizeTip: Feed with diluted liquid fertilizer, on damp soil — never bone-dry.
today.toastRootsOk: Roots fine — checking {name} again next spring
today.actionFailed: That didn't save — check your connection and try again

add.title: Add a plant
add.snapBody: Point your camera at the plant and Sprout will figure out what it is, then ask a couple of quick questions.
add.chooseSpeciesBody: Know what it is already? Pick it and skip the camera for now.
add.uncertainPrompt: Not 100% sure — which one looks right?
add.errorNotPlant: Couldn't find a plant in that photo. Try a clearer, closer shot or search manually.
add.errorBadPhoto: That photo couldn't be used. Try a different one.
add.errorLocked: Sprout is locked on this device — unlock it and try again.
add.errorIdentify: Couldn't identify that plant. Try a clearer photo or search manually.
add.errorCareInfo: Couldn't load care info for that plant. Try again in a moment.

plant.waterCheckFirst: Don't water on a clock — check the soil first and water only when the top ~2″ is dry.
plant.waterExpects: Sprout expects {name} to get thirsty about every {days} days right now, and tunes that each time you check.
plant.waterLearning: Last check it was still moist, so it's learning to wait longer.
plant.waterSpeciesGuide: Species guide: ~{summer}d in spring/summer, ~{winter}d in fall/winter.
plant.howFinger: Finger — poke to your second knuckle (~2″). Cool or damp? Wait. Dry? Water.
plant.howChopstick: Chopstick — push in, pull out. Comes out clean and dry means it's time.
plant.howLift: Lift the pot — light = dry, heavy = still wet. Learn the feel right after watering.
plant.fertilizeBody: Feed about every {days} days with a balanced liquid fertilizer at {strength}, on damp soil.
plant.fertilizeSeasonNorth: Spring and summer only (Apr–Sep). Sprout pauses feeding in fall and winter, and for 6 weeks after repotting.
plant.fertilizeSeasonSouth: Spring and summer only (Oct–Mar). Sprout pauses feeding in fall and winter, and for 6 weeks after repotting.
plant.noDrainageWarning: No drainage hole — water lightly and watch for sogginess.
plant.repotBody: Check the roots each spring; usually every {months} months
plant.historyEmpty: Nothing logged yet — your care shows up here.
plant.removeConfirm: Remove {name} from your garden? This can't be undone.
